text:
9. 1. 5

Sujātasuttaṃ

399. Sāvatthiyaṃ-

Atha kho āyasmā sujāto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. Addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sujātaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ. Disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi:

Ubhayenevāyaṃ bhikkhave, kulaputto sobhati: yañca abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato, yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī'ti. Idamavoca bhagavā. Idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:

Sobhati vatāyaṃ bhikkhu ujubhūtena cetasā, 

Vippamutto visaññutto anupādāya nibbuto, 

Dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ jetvā māraṃ savāhininti.
